name: cloud-posture-review
description: Two roles, one pipeline and one skill for read-only cloud posture and IAM review, where a check that could not run is NOT-CHECKED with its reason rather than a PASS.

skills.name: exposure-check
skills.line: Will not conclude "not exposed": the verdict names the checks that ran, their regions and the principal, and every denied API call is listed as a denial rather than a negative.
